parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence, no facility or border restriction, no organised targeting or sweeps are documented; the repealed sodomy statute was unenforced for years and no enforcement against gender-diverse people is shown. The operative negative is tier 3: documented societal hostility with thin recourse — police dismiss anti-trans violence based on ID markers (practical impunity), and health-care settings turn trans people away, partially offset by a 2020 SOP mandating gender-identity-sensitive GBV care and an emerging institutional dialogue (UN-trained judiciary, first community-parliament contact). The 4x assault multiplier lacks verifiable basis and cannot be weighted precisely. No universal-exposure exposure reaches visitors' crossings, facilities or custody on the record. This resembles a reduced-risk profile whose documented recourse failure for trans victims and care-access discrimination hold it below 0.65: uncertainty noted, but the worst documented features are service discrimination and ignored violence reports, not institutional exclusion or state targeting.
